name: regex

import { stdout } from std.io;
fn main(): Void { inmut pattern = re'a+'; stdout.println(pattern.matches("baac")); stdout.println(pattern.replace("baac", "x")); stdout.println(re'\p{Letter}'.matches("λ")); stdout.println(re'\p{Greek}'.matches("λ")); stdout.println(re'\p{Emoji}'.matches("🧠")); stdout.println(re'(?i)k'.matches("K")); }

true
bxc
true
